title: SUMMARY RECORD OF THE TWENTY-FIFTH MEETING (corrigendum)

pages.text:
UNITED NATIONS / NATIONS UNIES
ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL COUNCIL / CONSEIL ECONOMIQUE ET SOCIAL

UNRESTRICTED
E/CN.4/SR 25.Corr.1
2 December 1947
FRENCH ONLY

COMMISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS
SECOND SESSION

SUMMARY RECORD OF THE TWENTY-FIFTH MEETING

held at the Palais des Nations, Geneva,
on Tuesday, 2 December 1947, at 3.55 p.m.

In the footnote at the bottom of page 1, read:

"Twenty-sixth meeting" instead of
"Twenty-fifth meeting".
